title: Claude Code rejects the daemon's resources/read result, so MCP resources are unreadable from that client
wanted_capability: Read a Blackbox MCP resource (for example blackbox://skills/onboard-project/SKILL.md) from a Claude Code session. The client validates the resources/read result and requires a numeric ttlMs and a cacheScope of public or private; the daemon's result carries only contents, so the read fails client-side even though the daemon answered.
missing_primitive: ttlMs and cacheScope on the resources/read result for the protocol revision this client speaks
fallback_used: Opened a raw MCP session with curl on protocol 2025-06-18 using the service bearer and read the resource there; that read succeeded and returned result keys [contents] only.
evidence: src/server/handler.rs: list handlers set ttl_ms and cache_scope, read_resource does not
client error: Invalid result for resources/read: ttlMs expected number received undefined; cacheScope expected public|private
system-defaults/skills/bbox-onboard-project/SKILL.md directs agents to this resource for live checkout hosts
resources/list from the same session succeeded
notes: Observed after the daemon restarted under a live Claude Code session, so the session reconnected without a new process. Not verified whether a freshly started Claude Code session, which performs its own handshake, fails the same way. The bbox-onboard-project skill still works without the resource: its procedure is self-contained and the resource only adds the live checkout-host table.
